{
  "contents": "#!/bin/bash\n\n# Cursor Backup Script\n# Creates a backup archive of ~/.cursor excluding large directories\n# but includes manifests of their contents\n\nset -e\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)\nBACKUP_FILE=\"$HOME/cursor-backup-$TIMESTAMP.tar.gz\"\nCURSOR_DIR=\"$HOME/.cursor\"\n\necho \"Creating manifests...\"\n\n# Create manifest of worktrees directory\necho \"  - Scanning worktrees/ ...\"\nfind \"$CURSOR_DIR/worktrees\" -type f -exec ls -lh {} \\; 2>/dev/null | \\\n    awk '{print $9, \"(\" $5 \")\"}' > /tmp/worktrees_manifest.txt\nWORKTREES_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/worktrees_manifest.txt | tr -d ' ')\necho \"    Found $WORKTREES_COUNT files\"\n\n# Create manifest of extensions directory\necho \"  - Scanning extensions/ ...\"\nfind \"$CURSOR_DIR/extensions\" -type f -exec ls -lh {} \\; 2>/dev/null | \\\n    awk '{print $9, \"(\" $5 \")\"}' > /tmp/extensions_manifest.txt\nEXTENSIONS_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/extensions_manifest.txt | tr -d ' ')\necho \"    Found $EXTENSIONS_COUNT files\"\n\n# Copy manifests to cursor dir temporarily\ncp /tmp/worktrees_manifest.txt \"$CURSOR_DIR/\"\ncp /tmp/extensions_manifest.txt \"$CURSOR_DIR/\"\n\necho \"Creating backup archive...\"\ntar -czf \"$BACKUP_FILE\" \\\n    -C \"$CURSOR_DIR\" \\\n    --exclude='worktrees' \\\n    --exclude='extensions' \\\n    . \\\n    worktrees_manifest.txt \\\n    extensions_manifest.txt\n\n# Clean up temporary manifests\nrm \"$CURSOR_DIR/worktrees_manifest.txt\"\nrm \"$CURSOR_DIR/extensions_manifest.txt\"\nrm /tmp/worktrees_manifest.txt\nrm /tmp/extensions_manifest.txt\n\n# Show results\nBACKUP_SIZE=$(ls -lh \"$BACKUP_FILE\" | awk '{print $5}')\necho \"\"\necho \"✓ Backup completed successfully!\"\necho \"  File: $BACKUP_FILE\"\necho \"  Size: $BACKUP_SIZE\"\necho \"  Manifests included:\"\necho \"    - worktrees_manifest.txt ($WORKTREES_COUNT files)\"\necho \"    - extensions_manifest.txt ($EXTENSIONS_COUNT files)\"\n",

then\n    cp -p \"$1\" \"$2\"\n  fi\n}\n\n# MCP\ncopy_if \"$CURSOR_DIR/mcp.json\" \"$OUT/mcp.json\"\ncopy_if \"$CURSOR_DIR/mcp.servers.stash.json\" \"$OUT/mcp.servers.stash.json\"\ncopy_if \"$CURSOR_DIR/.mcp-servers-disabled\" \"$OUT/mcp-servers-disabled.marker\"\n\n# User settings (resolve symlink)\nif [[ -f \"$USER_DATA/settings.json\" ]]; Canonical notes: [`docs/COMPENDIUM.md`](../docs/COMPENDIUM.md).\n\nThis directory is a **portable scaffold** for a **sibling private git repository** that aggregates:\n\n- Mirrored project `.cursor/` and optional `.specstory/`\n- Copies of **global** plans (`~/.cursor/plans`) and **per-project** `.cursor/plans`\n- **`skills-registry/`** manifests (vendor vs authored vs project-index)\n\n## Bootstrap\n\n1. Copy this entire `compendium/` tree to a new path (e.g. `~/src/dotfiles-cursor-compendium`).\n2. `cd` there, `git init`, create a **private** remote (`gh repo create ... --private --source=. --push`).\n3. Set **`export CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT`** to that directory in your shell profile (or use absolute paths in `launchd`).\n4. Edit `skills-registry/*.yaml` from the examples; add project roots to `project-index.yaml`.\n5. Run `scripts/snapshot-all.sh` (dry review) then commit.\n\n**Source of truth:** Document per artifact whether you edit in the **product repo**, **`~/.cursor`**, or **only** in this compendium. Keep the GitHub repo **private**. Snapshot scripts exclude common secret filenames—extend the denylist before mirroring a new project class.\n\n## Automation\n\nSee `launchd/` for an optional **daily** snapshot + commit example. Edit the `RSYNC_EXCLUDES` variable in each script before mirroring new sensitive patterns.\n\n## Files\n\n| Script | Role |\n| --- | --- |\n| `discover-project-paths.py` | Merge **Cursor-known** workspace roots with a **disk scan** for `.cursor/`, `.claude/`, `.specstory/` under `~/projects`, `~/tools`, optional roots, and shallow `$HOME`; write `project-paths.txt` + `discover-report.json` (orphans vs stale). |\n| `sync-global-plans.sh` | `~/.cursor/plans` → `plans/global/` |\n| `snapshot-project.sh` | One project `.cursor/`, `.cursor/plans`, optional `.specstory` rules-only |\n| `snapshot-all.sh` | Runs discover (unless `COMPENDIUM_AUTO_DISCOVER=0`), then global plans, then each line in `project-paths.txt` |\n\nBootstrap once from `project-paths.example.txt` if you need a template; day-to-day, prefer **`discover-project-paths.py`** so paths stay aligned with Cursor and disk. The YAML `project-index.yaml` is for documentation and richer metadata.\n\n### discover flags\n\n- `--dry-run` — print JSON summary only; **no writes** (use `--verbose` for full path lists).\n- `--compendium-root DIR` — write `project-paths.txt` and `discover-report.json` here (same as `CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT` for `snapshot-all.sh`).\n- `--extra-root PATH` — repeat to scan another top-level tree (unlimited depth like `projects`/`tools`).\n- `--home-maxdepth N` — shallow `$HOME` walk depth (default 5); set `0` to skip the home pass.\n",

It merges paths Cursor knows from `workspaceStorage` / `globalStorage` with a scan for `.cursor/`, `.claude/`, and `.specstory/` under `~/projects`, `~/tools`, and a shallow `$HOME` pass. Orphans (on disk only) get `orphan-…` slugs; see `discover-report.json`. Copy from `project-paths.example.txt` only for a cold start. Fill **`skills-registry/*.yaml`** for vendor vs authored inventory.\n\nPersonal skill: **`~/.cursor/skills/compendium-discover-projects/SKILL.md`**\n\n## Scheduled daily snapshot + commit\n\n1. Confirm paths inside the plist match `CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT` and that `git` in the plist environment can push (SSH or HTTPS credential helper).\n\nThe plist runs `snapshot-all.sh` (which runs **discover** then global plans then per-project snapshots), then commits only if the index changed.   "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\n\n# Usage: snapshot-project.sh <slug> <absolute-project-root>\n# Mirrors .cursor/ (excluding mcp.json), .cursor/plans, and .specstory/**/*.mdc rules if present (not full history by default).\n\nif [[ \"${#}\" -ne 2 ]]; then\n  echo \"Usage: $0 <slug> <absolute-project-root>\" >&2\n  exit 1\nfi\n\nSLUG=\"$1\"\nPROJ=\"$2\"\nROOT=\"${CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT:?Set CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT}\"\n\nif [[ ! -d \"${PROJ}\" ]]; then\n  echo \"Project path not a directory: ${PROJ}\" >&2\n  exit 1\nfi\n\nMIRROR=\"${ROOT}/mirrors/by-project/${SLUG}\"\nmkdir -p \"${MIRROR}\"\n\nif [[ -d \"${PROJ}/.cursor\" ]]; then\n  rsync -a \\\n    --exclude='mcp.json' \\\n    --exclude='.DS_Store' \\\n    \"${PROJ}/.cursor/\" \"${MIRROR}/.cursor/\"\nfi\n\nif [[ -d \"${PROJ}/.cursor/plans\" ]]; then\n  mkdir -p \"${ROOT}/plans/by-project/${SLUG}\"\n  rsync -a \"${PROJ}/.cursor/plans/\" \"${ROOT}/plans/by-project/${SLUG}/\"\nfi\n\n# SpecStory: rules and small text only (tune excludes for your policy)\nif [[ -d \"${PROJ}/.specstory\" ]]; then\n  mkdir -p \"${MIRROR}/.specstory\"\n  rsync -a \\\n    --exclude='history/' \\\n    \"${PROJ}/.specstory/\" \"${MIRROR}/.specstory/\" || true\nfi\n\necho \"Snapshot ${PROJ} -> mirrors/by-project/${SLUG}/ (+ plans if any)\"\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 45
}

macOS file:///Users/... vs file:/Users\n        if path.startswith(\"/\") and len(path) > 2 and path[2] == \":\":\n            path = path[1:]  # rare Windows-style\n        return path\n    return None\n\n\ndef parse_code_workspace_file(ws_file: Path) -> list[str]:\n    out: list[str] = []\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(ws_file.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):\n        return out\n    base = ws_file.parent\n    for entry in data.get(\"folders\") or []:\n        p = entry.get(\"path\")\n        if not p:\n            continue\n        fp = Path(p)",

{
  "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Mirror live Cursor skills into the dotfiles repo for version control + backup.\n#\n# Copies ~/.cursor/skills and ~/.cursor/skills-cursor into\n# cursor/compendium/mirrors/skills-snapshots/, dereferencing symlinks so skills\n# that actually live in other repos are captured too. Junk (caches, .DS_Store,\n# node_modules, .git) is excluded. Run periodically or before big changes, then\n# commit the result.\n#\n# Usage:\n#   snapshot-skills.sh              # mirror into the default location\n#   snapshot-skills.sh /path/to/dir # custom destination root\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nREPO_CURSOR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nDEST=\"${1:-$REPO_CURSOR/compendium/mirrors/skills-snapshots}\"\nCURSOR_DIR=\"${CURSOR_DIR:-$HOME/.cursor}\"\n\ncommand -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo \"rsync is required\" >&2; exit 1; }\n\nmkdir -p \"$DEST\"\n\n# -a archive, -L dereference symlinks (capture linked skill content),\n# --delete keep the mirror in sync with the live tree.\nRSYNC_EXCLUDES=(\n  --exclude '.git/'\n  --exclude '__pycache__/'\n  --exclude '*.pyc'\n  --exclude '.DS_Store'\n  --exclude 'node_modules/'\n  --exclude '.venv/'\n)\n\nfor tree in skills skills-cursor; do\n  src=\"$CURSOR_DIR/$tree\"\n  if [[ ! -d \"$src\" ]]; then\n    echo \"skip: $src not found\" >&2\n    continue\n  fi\n  rsync -aL --delete \"${RSYNC_EXCLUDES[@]}\" \"$src/\" \"$DEST/$tree/\"\n  echo \"mirrored: $src -> $DEST/$tree\" >&2\ndone\n\n# Provenance / quick-diff manifest, including which entries were symlinks.\n{\n  echo \"# Cursor skills snapshot\"\n  echo \"generated: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\"\n  echo \"source: $CURSOR_DIR/{skills,skills-cursor}\"\n  echo \"note: symlinked skills are dereferenced (real content copied into mirror)\"\n  echo\n  echo \"## symlinked skills at snapshot time\"\n  find \"$CURSOR_DIR/skills\" \"$CURSOR_DIR/skills-cursor\" -maxdepth 1 -type l \\\n    -exec sh -c 'printf \"%s -> %s\\n\" \"$1\" \"$(readlink \"$1\")\"' _ {} \\; 2>/dev/null | sort\n} > \"$DEST/MANIFEST.txt\"\n\necho \"Skills mirrored to: $DEST\" >&2\necho \"$DEST\"\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 60
}

Run discover-project-paths.py or copy project-paths.example.txt.\"\n  exit 0\nfi\n\nwhile IFS=$'\\t' read -r slug path; do\n  [[ -z \"${slug}\" || \"${slug}\" =~ ^# ]] && continue\n  [[ -z \"${path}\" ]] && continue\n  \"${ROOT}/scripts/snapshot-project.sh\" \"${slug}\" \"${path}\"\ndone < \"${PATHS}\"\n\necho \"snapshot-all complete.\"\n",

  "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDiscover Cursor / Agents skills across global and project locations.\n\nWrites under CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT (or --compendium-root):\n  - skills-registry/skills-inventory.json\n  - skills-registry/skills-inventory.md\n\nDoes not install or mirror skills; run snapshot-skills.sh and snapshot-all.sh for backups.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nHOME = Path.home()\nCURSOR_DIR = HOME / \".cursor\"\nAGENTS_DIR = HOME / \".agents\" / \"skills\"\nSCAN_ROOTS = [\n    HOME / \"projects\",\n    HOME / \"tools\",\n    HOME / \"src\",\n]\n\n}\n\n\ndef slug_from_path(path: Path) -> str:\n    try:\n        out = subprocess.run(\n            [\"git\", \"-C\", str(path), \"remote\", \"get-url\", \"origin\"],\n            capture_output=True,\n            text=True,\n            timeout=5,\n        )\n        if out.returncode == 0 and out.stdout.strip():\n            url = out.stdout.strip()\n            m = re.search(r\"github\\.com[:/]([^/]+)/([^/.]+)\", url)\n            if m:\n                return f\"github-com-{m.group(1)}-{m.group(2)}\"\n    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):\n        pass\n    digest = path.as_posix().encode(\"utf-8\")\n    import hashlib\n",

_**Agent**_

Here is the full picture, what was already in place, and what we wired up today.

## The three skill tiers

| Tier | Live location | Source of truth | Backup |
|------|---------------|-----------------|--------|
| **Cursor-managed** | `~/.cursor/skills-cursor/` | Cursor (don't edit) | `mirrors/skills-snapshots/skills-cursor/` |
| **User global** | `~/.cursor/skills/` | You (often symlinked from a project repo) | `mirrors/skills-snapshots/skills/` |
| **Agents global** | `~/.agents/skills/` | You / upstream installs | `mirrors/skills-snapshots/agents-skills/` |
| **Project-local** | `<project>/.cursor/skills/<name>/` | **The product git repo** | `mirrors/by-project/<slug>/.cursor/skills/` via `snapshot-project.sh` |

Project-local skills were **already designed** to be captured: `snapshot-project.sh` rsyncs the entire `.cursor/` tree, which includes `.cursor/skills/`. The gap was that nobody had been running the compendium snapshots (`project-paths.txt` in the sibling repo was empty).

Discovery found **56 project-local skills** across your projects (e.g. `writing-quality-pipeline`, `proposal-critique`, `cidr-letterhead` in `library__cidrlab`, etc.). Those should live in their **project repos** as canonical copies; the compendium is the cross-project backup.

## What is the compendium?

A **private backup/index repo** for Cursor artifacts scattered across machines and projects:

- Mirrored project `.cursor/` (rules, hooks, **skills**, etc.)
- Global and per-project **plans**
- Optional `.specstory/` snippets
- Global skills snapshots

**When/why created:** May 16, 2026, following your `bootstrap-tool-config-repo` skill. The scaffold landed in dotfiles on **2026-06-12** (`4ef330f`). The live sibling repo is:

- **Path:** `~/src/dotfiles-cursor-compendium`
- **Remote:** `aculich/dotfiles-cursor-compendium` (**PRIVATE**)

`CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT` should point there. Dotfiles keeps the **canonical scripts**; the sibling is where operational snapshots were meant to land.

## What is skills-registry?

**Inventory manifests only** — not installers. YAML schema for provenance:

- `vendor.yaml` — third-party / marketplace skills
- `authored.yaml` — skills you maintain (with optional dedicated repo)
- `project-index.yaml` — which projects to snapshot

These were scaffolded empty (`[]`) in May 2026 and never filled in. We added **generated** inventory:

- `skills-inventory.json` — machine scan (88 global + 56 project-local)
- `skills-inventory.md` — human-readable index

## Privacy (verified)

Both remotes are **PRIVATE**:

- `aculich/dotfiles`
- `aculich/dotfiles-cursor-compendium`

New script: `cursor/scripts/verify-private-remotes.sh` — run this before any `git push` on skills/compendium data.

**Nothing was pushed** — commits are local only, per your rules.

## What we implemented today

1. **`snapshot-skills.sh`** — now mirrors `~/.cursor/skills`, `skills-cursor`, and `~/.agents/skills` (dereferencing symlinks)
2. **`discover-skills.py`** — scans global + project trees, writes inventory
3. **`snapshot-all-skills.sh`** — one command for globals + inventory + privacy check
4. **`verify-private-remotes.sh`** — blocks push if a remote isn't private
5. **`cursor/docs/SKILLS-MANAGEMENT.md`** — full workflow doc
6. **Committed** in both repos:
   - `dotfiles`: `9e8a8b0`
   - `dotfiles-cursor-compendium`: `ddedcf6`

## Your ongoing workflow

```bash
# Globals + inventory (~3 min for discovery scan)
~/dotfiles/cursor/scripts/snapshot-all-skills.sh
cd ~/dotfiles && git commit -am 'chore: update skills snapshot'

# Project-local backups (includes .cursor/skills per project)
export CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT=~/src/dotfiles-cursor-compendium
cd "$CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT"
./scripts/snapshot-all.sh    # discover projects, sync plans, mirror each .cursor/
git commit -am 'chore(compendium): snapshot'

# Before pushing either repo
~/dotfiles/cursor/scripts/verify-private-remotes.sh
git push   # only after verify passes
```

## Architecture note

You now have **two copies** of global skills mirrors:

- `dotfiles/cursor/compendium/mirrors/skills-snapshots/` (committed today)
- `~/src/dotfiles-cursor-compendium/mirrors/skills-snapshots/` (sibling compendium)

That matches the original design: dotfiles = scaffold + scripts; sibling compendium = operational backup repo. Project-local skills still need a `snapshot-all.sh` run to populate `mirrors/by-project/` — that step hasn't been done yet (it will take longer since it walks every discovered project).

If you want, I can run `snapshot-all.sh` against the sibling compendium next to back up all project-local `.cursor/skills/` trees, or push both local commits after another privacy verify.

{
  "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Snapshot all skill tiers: global Cursor, agents, and refresh inventory.\n#\n# Project-local skills are mirrored when you run compendium/scripts/snapshot-all.sh\n# (snapshot-project.sh rsyncs each project's .cursor/, including .cursor/skills/).\n#\n# Usage:\n#   snapshot-all-skills.sh\n\nset -euo pipefail\n\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nREPO_CURSOR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nCOMPENDIUM_ROOT=\"${CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT:-$REPO_CURSOR/compendium}\"\nDOTFILES_CURSOR=\"${DOTFILES_CURSOR:-$REPO_CURSOR}\"\n\nexport CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT=\"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT\"\nexport DOTFILES_CURSOR\n\necho \"==> verify remotes are private\" >&2\n\"$SCRIPT_DIR/verify-private-remotes.sh\" \"$(cd \"$REPO_CURSOR/..\" && pwd)\" \"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT\" 2>/dev/null || \\\n  \"$SCRIPT_DIR/verify-private-remotes.sh\" \"$(cd \"$REPO_CURSOR/..\" && pwd)\"\n\necho \"==> mirror global ~/.cursor/skills + skills-cursor + ~/.agents/skills\" >&2\n\"$SCRIPT_DIR/snapshot-skills.sh\" \"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT/mirrors/skills-snapshots\"\n\necho \"==> discover skills inventory\" >&2\nDISCOVER_PY=\"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT/scripts/discover-skills.py\"\nif [[ ! -f \"$DISCOVER_PY\" ]]; then\n  DISCOVER_PY=\"$DOTFILES_CURSOR/compendium/scripts/discover-skills.py\"\nfi\npython3 \"$DISCOVER_PY\" --compendium-root \"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT\"\n\nif [[ -f \"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT/scripts/snapshot-all.sh\" && \"${SNAPSHOT_PROJECT_SKILLS:-0}\" == \"1\" ]]; then\n  echo \"==> snapshot project .cursor/ trees (including project-local skills)\" >&2\n  \"$COMPENDIUM_ROOT/scripts/snapshot-all.sh\"\nfi\n\necho \"snapshot-all-skills complete: $COMPENDIUM_ROOT\" >&2\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 40
}

Since they're asking for regular snapshots, I'll offer a launchd install recipe but keep the default workflow manual so users stay in control.

The cleanest approach is to let `just skill-backup` handle occasional updates to the dotfiles mirror and inventory, while a separate daily launchd job runs the compendium snapshot and commits there, keeping churn isolated. Now I'll write out the justfile with these recipes and variable setup.

_**Agent**_

The `@` prefix only suppresses the echo of the first physical line, but since this is a line continuation with backslashes, the entire command is treated as one line—so the header echo statements aren't printing. The loop body is executing, but rsync's `-i` flag with everything already in sync produces no output. The `|| true` wraps the whole pipeline, so that's fine. The `$$` escapes to `$` in just, and single braces stay literal since just uses double-brace interpolation, so `$${t%%:*}` correctly becomes `${t%%:*}` for bash. Rather than keep debugging this complex one-liner, I should rewrite the skill-drift recipe as a proper shebang script like install-daily for clarity and correctness.

_**Agent**_

The drift detection is working correctly now—the `T` flag indicates that only the timestamp differs between files, not the actual content or size. This happens because the dotfiles mirror was created at a different time than its sibling, with the initial snapshot run writing at 20:02 and subsequent runs updating the sibling instead.

The real issue is that `CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT` controls which compendium gets snapshotted, so if it's set to the sibling, the dotfiles mirror path in the justfile won't get updated. To keep `just skill-backup` coherent and always targeting the dotfiles mirror, I need to explicitly pass `CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT="{{cursor_dir}}/compendium"` to force the dotfiles path, while keeping the `compendium` variable (which points to the sibling) for other recipes like `skill-backup-full`.

_**Agent**_

The fast backup completes quickly at around 1.5 seconds, but there's an issue: the MANIFEST.txt timestamp gets updated on every run, creating a commit with just that one trivial change even when nothing else has actually changed. This generates unnecessary noise in the commit history.

I'm weighing a few approaches: I could exclude MANIFEST.txt from version control entirely, but that loses the provenance record. I could accept daily timestamp-only commits as a reasonable artifact of the automated job. Or I could remove the volatile `generated` timestamp line from MANIFEST.txt altogether and rely on git's commit metadata to track when snapshots occurred — that way MANIFEST only changes when the actual symlink content changes, eliminating the noise commits entirely. I'm leaning toward stripping out that timestamp line from the snapshot script, though I'd need to adjust skill-status to read the snapshot date from git history instead.

## How to keep skills backed up regularly

Three composable options (documented in `SKILLS-MANAGEMENT.md`):

1. **Manual/frequent:** `just skill-backup-fast` — mirrors global skills and commits in ~2s. Commits **only when content actually changed** (no-op otherwise, so no noise commits).
2. **Automated daily:** `just install-daily` — installs a launchd agent running `just skill-backup` at 06:15, committing to dotfiles locally.
3. **Project-local + plans:** the existing compendium launchd example runs `snapshot-all.sh` (which now also refreshes the global skills mirror) and commits to the sibling repo.

Nothing is ever auto-pushed — run `just remotes` then `git push` when you want to sync.

## The justfile recipes

```
just              # list recipes
just status       # git status (dotfiles + compendium) + skill counts + remote privacy
just skill-status # live-vs-mirror counts, inventory time, last mirror commit
just skill-drift  # rsync dry-run: exactly which skills changed since last backup
just skill-backup       # full: mirror + inventory scan (~3min) + commit
just skill-backup-fast  # fast: mirror + commit, skips project scan (~2s)
just skill-backup-full  # also mirrors project-local .cursor/skills via compendium
just skill-discover     # regenerate skills-inventory.{json,md}
just remotes            # verify GitHub remotes are private
just config-snapshot    # snapshot mcp/settings/extensions
just install-daily / uninstall-daily / daily-status
```

## Key fixes made while building it

- Added a `SKILL_DISCOVER=0` fast path so quick backups skip the slow 3-min project scan.
- Removed the volatile `generated:` timestamp from `MANIFEST.txt` so backups don't create empty timestamp-only commits — verified a second `skill-backup-fast` run correctly reports "No skill changes to commit."
- `skill-status` now reports the last mirror **git commit** rather than a file timestamp.
- Pinned `skill-backup`/`skill-backup-fast` to the dotfiles mirror so the committed copy is always the one refreshed, regardless of `CURSOR_COMPENDIUM_ROOT`.

All verified working. Recommended daily driver: `just skill-backup-fast`, or `just install-daily` to automate it.
